hook.text: Surgeons don't see blood as disgusting. They trained their brains to see it as data. Framing is everything.

buildup.text: Cognitive reframing means changing the story around a disgust trigger without changing the trigger itself.

discovery.text: Studies show labeling a gross stimulus as 'scientific' reduces the disgust response by up to 30%.

twist.text: Chefs reframe animal butchering as craft. Morticians reframe death care as honor. Same reality, new frame.

climax.text: Reframing doesn't eliminate disgust. It gives the rational brain enough room to act despite the feeling.

punchline.text: You can't always change what's gross. You can change the story.

quiz.question: How much can 'scientific' labeling reduce disgust?
